item.title: Herada Featured in the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
item.description: Herada was recently featured in the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette as one of six startups to watch following completion of the Anvil Founder Coaching Program.

item.title: Completing the Anvil Founder Coaching Program
item.description: Herada recently completed the Anvil Founder Coaching Program, an experience that provided structured support during a critical stage of our development.

item.title: Reaching an Early Funding Milestone
item.description: We're excited to share that Herada has raised $100,000 in early funding.

item.title: Pittsburgh Techstars Startup Weekend 2025: Second Place
item.description: Herada participated in Pittsburgh Techstars Startup Weekend 2025, where we were honored to win second place.
